chain_shape: fetch->bronze(glue|batch)->[b2s->_staging x3 + compact-shadow x3 + gold]->gate->promote(compact-canonical x3)
one_off_backfill: none for a within-year gap: the current-year self-window + skip-existing fetchers self-heal on the first canary; a cross-year gap needs a windowed backfill (see notes)
notes: COHERENCE (SILVER-F047): compact_weather_silver reads per-source SILVER (silver/weather/source=<s>/commodity=<c>/), NOT bronze, so per-source b2s MUST run to advance silver -- but b2s write MONTH-grain and the ShadowPublisher never retires, so a b2s write under commodity= would leave month-grain alongside the compacted year-grain and extractors._paths_with_year_partitions + gold_weather_z._read_long would DOUBLE-READ every weather row (the hazard retire_projected_weather_task exists for). DESIGN: the 3 b2s write month-grain to the _staging tier (silver/weather/source=<s>/_staging/commodity=<c>/..., OUTSIDE the commodity= data plane, invisible to the extractor + gold); the 3 compact tasks read canonical UNION _staging, merge within-year, publish the coarse [commodity, year] object canonically (shadow in [Silver], canonical in [Promote]), then RETIRE (best-effort delete) the staging months they consumed. Canonical stays clean year-grain. b2s self-window to the CURRENT year on the daily 'all' path (bounded staging) and process every year on a named-commodity backfill (unchanged). DATA-FLOW: fetch(nasa raw / chirps bronze / cpc raw) -> bronze(nasa r2b glue / cpc r2b batch) -> [Silver serialized Map: b2s x3 -> _staging ; compact x3 --publish-mode shadow ; gold_weather_z folded LAST reads canonical] -> [Gate over 5 weather tables] -> [Promote serialized: compact x3 --publish-mode canonical under silver-publisher-runner + KMS] -> [Reconcile]. GOLD LAG: gold_weather_z is latest_only reading canonical directly, so it runs on its OWN gold-weather-z jobdef in the folded silver phase and reflects the PREVIOUS cycle's fully-promoted canonical (this cycle's compact-canonical lands in [Promote], AFTER gold). For a MONTHLY z-anomaly refreshed daily this one-cycle lag is immaterial, converges within 24h, and gold never reads an in-flight (mid-promote) canonical. Putting gold in [Promote] was rejected: the renderer routes every promote task to leviathan-dev-silver-publisher-runner (not gold's embedder jobdef, which its heavy raw-weather transform is sized for). G7: chirps silver/bronze current to ~May-2026 and cpc raw to 2026-05-22 -- both WITHIN the current year -- so the current-year self-window + skip-existing fetchers refetch Jun/Jul on the FIRST canary and no separate one-off backfill is needed; a cross-year gap would need per-source `--commodity all --start-year <Y> --end-year <cur>` (nasa) / `--year <Y>` (chirps/cpc). Family gate spans all 5 weather tables; silver_modis_ndvi is refreshed by the separate modis_biweekly schedule.
